titulo: Trump reportedly casts mail-in ballot in Florida Republican primary
cuerpo: President, who has decried mail-in ballots amid false claims of election fraud, issued March order to curb voting by mail Donald Trump voted by mail in Florida’s Republican primary, Politico reports, citing Palm Beach county voting records. The White House has confirmed the president’s mail-in vote, according to the New York Times , which added that this is at least the third time the president has mailed his ballot. In March, the president signed an executive ⁠order restricting the ​use of mail-in ballots ahead of the November midterm elections that will decide control of US Congress. Trump has repeatedly criticized mail-in voting, calling for restrictions on the policy for years and falsely claiming that his 2020 election defeat was the result of widespread voter fraud.
